description: This Java source file defines the ServiceXaWrapper class, which is an XA resource wrapper used for managing transactional services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles commit and rollback operations by invoking specified services asynchronously or synchronously during transaction phases, and is marked as deprecated in favor of ServiceSynchronization.

classes.name: ServiceXaWrapper
classes.description: A deprecated XA resource wrapper for managing transactional service calls, supporting commit and rollback operations, with options for asynchronous execution.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Sets the service to run upon transaction commit, with optional context and execution mode parameters.

methods.name: getCommitService
methods.description: Returns the name of the commit service configured.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Sets the commit service with context and execution mode parameters.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Sets the commit service with specific user, context, async and persist flags.

methods.name: getCommitContext
methods.description: Returns the context map used for the commit service.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Sets the service to run upon rollback, with context.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Sets the rollback service with async and persist options.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Sets the rollback service with specific user, context, async and persist flags.

methods.name: getRollbackService
methods.description: Returns the name of the rollback service.

methods.name: getRollbackContext
methods.description: Returns the context map used for the rollback service.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Performs the commit operation, invoking the configured commit service asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Performs the rollback operation, invoking the configured rollback service asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Overrides the prepare method to log transaction preparation details.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in a transaction, with verbose logging.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Internal method to execute a service call during transaction phases, handling transaction suspension, resume, and invoking the service via the dispatch context.
